from flask import Flask

from portal.db import close_db
from portal.extensions import db, login_manager


def create_app(config_object="portal.config.ProductionConfig"):
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.from_object(config_object)
    if not app.config.get("SECRET_KEY"):
        raise RuntimeError("SECRET_KEY must be set")

    db.init_app(app)
    login_manager.init_app(app)
    app.teardown_appcontext(close_db)

    from portal.views import register

    register(app)
    return app

def apply_payment_event(event):
    if event.get("type") != "payment.succeeded":
        log.debug("ignoring %s", event.get("type"))
        return
    data = event["data"]
    payment = Payment.query.filter_by(external_id=data["id"]).first()
    if payment is None:

    else:

    db.session.commit()

import logging

from portal.extensions import db
from portal.models import Payment

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def apply_payment_event(event):
    if event.get("type") != "payment.succeeded":
        log.debug("ignoring %s", event.get("type"))
        return
    data = event["data"]
    payment = Payment.query.filter_by(external_id=data["id"]).first()
    if payment is None:
        payment = Payment(external_id=data["id"], amount_cents=data["amount"], status="succeeded")
        db.session.add(payment)
    else:
        payment.status = "succeeded"
    db.session.commit()
